issues.where: the colony of perched animals across the terraces
issues.what: dozens of near-identical model copies in the same S-neck, wings-half-open pose with the same smooth grey skin; clearly instanced clones
issues.fix: vary pose, scale, wing state and skin tone per animal and break up the repeated silhouette

issues.where: the stepped cliff face on the right
issues.what: rock is a stack of regular slab terraces with one stretched grey material, same orange lichen dabs and same white drip streaks repeated on every step; reads as a procedural tiled block
issues.fix: break the regular stepping, vary strata and material, place guano/lichen by exposure instead of a uniform pattern

issues.where: the stone arches/horns behind the surf
issues.what: smooth tapered horn shapes with a single wood-grain-like stretched texture and no weathering; they read as plastic props, not sea stacks
issues.fix: give them fractured rock geometry, erosion, wet darkening at the base and atmospheric falloff

issues.what: texture smeared into long stretched streaks and faceted planes with reflective metallic smears; UV stretching obvious
issues.fix: fix projection/UVs on steep faces, use triplanar mapping and add real micro-detail

issues.what: vertical striped stretched-texture band in the rock and flat white ledge slabs with stretched streaks
issues.fix: repair UV stretching on vertical faces and give ledges thickness and wet/guano variation

issues.where: the animals' feet and wing tips on the ledges
issues.what: legs end in thin sticks that do not plant on the rock, no contact shadow, and the skin carries nothing of the place (no guano, wet or salt); wing edges have a smooth CG-model sheen
issues.fix: plant feet with contact shadows and occlusion, add grime/wet/salt to skin and roughen wing membranes

issues.where: the wading animals in the shallows
issues.what: animals are flat, low-detail silhouettes with identical outstretched wing poses, stick legs with no splash, wake, reflection or wet darkening where they meet the water
issues.fix: add ripples, splash and reflections at the legs, wet the plumage/skin, vary the poses

issues.where: x 0-17% and x 83-100%, y 25-42%, the side rock pillars
issues.what: rock is a soft noisy smear with streaky stretched texture and a liquid-like flowing pattern, looks like clay rather than stone
issues.fix: rebuild with real fracture geometry and sharp rock texture at this close distance

issues.where: the wet flat and the water edge across the lower frame
issues.what: water is a flat grey-blue sheet with no depth, almost no foam line or wet edge where it meets the rocks and reflects neither the sky nor the stacks
issues.fix: add a foam/wash edge, reflections of rocks and sky, and depth/transparency variation

issues.where: x 83-100%, y 58-75%, the far shore line
issues.what: the water plane meets the dark cliff on a hard straight cut with no surf, spray or contact
issues.fix: add breaking water, spray and a wet band at the cliff base

issues.where: x 0-17%, y 58-75%, far stacks in haze
issues.what: fog is a uniform flat blue tint over flat silhouette cards with no light variation
issues.fix: add depth-varying haze density and light shafts/sky illumination in the vapour

issues.what: spray partly breaks into flat white flecks pasted over a soft grey veil
issues.fix: give spray volume, droplet size variation and backlit translucency
